name: wingfoil-chart
summary: wingfoil.ie as an Admiralty chart crossed with an old broadsheet weather report: one paper and one ink, the chart's magenta for the best of something and the focus, a red pen for the one thing that matters, thin ink rules and double-rule frames, Fraunces, Newsreader, IBM Plex Mono and Kalam, and the puffin. Figures over prose, mobile first. Light is the product; dark is a proposed night chart.

namingGrammar.tokens: <tier>.<group...>.<name> — tier is 'ref' or 'sem'; every segment is lowercase kebab-case; nesting follows DTCG groups; aliases reference the full dotted path as {tier.group.name}. A sem colour carries the Tailwind name from ui/theme.css unchanged (--color-ink-muted -> sem.color.ink-muted), except the accent family, which is a group (--color-accent -> sem.color.accent.primary, --color-accent-hover -> sem.color.accent.hover); a type step's parts split by family (--text-lead -> sem.font.size.lead, --text-lead--line-height -> sem.font.line.lead, --text-lead--font-weight -> sem.font.weight.lead, --text-lead--letter-spacing -> sem.font.tracking.lead); spacing steps are sem.space.x<n> for Tailwind's *-<n>
namingGrammar.cssVariables: '--' plus the token path with '.' replaced by '-' (sem.color.ink-muted -> --sem-color-ink-muted, the product's --color-ink-muted); components consume only the --sem-* set
namingGrammar.components: kebab-case directory under components/, containing component.html, component.css, and component.md; a component that renders a ui/ primitive is named after it (ui/SearchField.tsx -> search-field); classes are .wf-<component> with __part and --modifier
namingGrammar.glyphs: kebab-case concept name, one concept per SVG; strokes and fills use currentColor

provenance.authoredBy: derived from the product by an agent, for review
derivedFrom: ui/theme.css (every design value; the drift check scripts/lint-design-tokens.mjs holds the two equal)
ui/*.tsx (the kit's primitives and their tailwind-variants recipes)
design/chart/1-the-chart.html in the wingfoil-design worktree, with design/chart/shots/1-*.jpg (the signed-off reference mockup)
docs/BRAND.md and docs/DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md (the rules and dated rulings)
